classification.rationale: SDE-governed staged language migration with preregistered compatibility and architecture claims

rd.researchQuestion: Can ROS move stable semantic authority into a typed F# application while preserving current observable contracts and operational safety?
rd.technicalUncertainty: The safest F# distribution model, exact compatibility surface, and first-slice boundary must be validated against current Node, Python, schema, packaging, and consumer constraints.
rd.experimentalObjective: Execute MIG-00 through the highest safe vertical slice with preregistered behavioral, architecture, differential, and rollback gates.
rd.knowledgeGap: No prospective F# implementation or distribution evidence exists yet, and the repository lacked an SDE v0.2 semantic map and feature manifests at T0.
alternativesEvaluated: typed F# semantic core with retained platform adapters
